parsed.reason: The message delivers exactly what a competent neighbour who looked something up would say. It leads with the required finding language ("I checked", "I also found"), states the registration date plainly with specifics (town, cycle, time), and names the weekend pick with venue and one clear reason (free, outdoor, dry forecast). It omits nothing the facts carry and invents nothing. The structure moves from registration to the immediate activity option, plain and direct.
